EnumContractHotloadOperation.description:
What a request or registry record does to one contract name.

Plan section 4 names the three: ``register`` (a name the registry has not
held, ``expected_version: 0``), ``replace`` (a new hash for a held name)
and ``remove``.
EnumContractHotloadOperation.title: EnumContractHotloadOperation

ModelContractLoadRequest.description:
A caller asks the registry to load or remove one contract by name and hash.

Attributes:
    operation: ``load`` or ``remove``.
    contract_name: The installed contract's name.
    content_hash: Canonical content hash of the contract the caller means.
    registration_request_id: Caller-chosen id; the reply and the registry
        record carry it back, so a resend is told from a new request.
    expected_version: The registry version the caller last saw for the name
        (``0`` for a name it has never seen); a mismatch is a conflict.
    owner: The principal that owns the registration.
ModelContractLoadRequest.title: ModelContractLoadRequest

EnumContractHotloadOperation.description:
What a request or registry record does to one contract name.

Plan section 4 names the three: ``register`` (a name the registry has not
held, ``expected_version: 0``), ``replace`` (a new hash for a held name)
and ``remove``.
EnumContractHotloadOperation.title: EnumContractHotloadOperation

ModelContractHotloadAccepted.description:
The compacted record of one accepted contract, keyed by its name.

Attributes:
    entity_id: The contract name (the record's compaction key).
    registry_version: The registry version this acceptance created.
    content_hash: Canonical content hash of the installed contract.
    operation: ``register`` or ``replace``.
    owner: The principal that owns the registration.
    registration_request_id: The request this acceptance answers.
    contract_yaml: The installed contract, as text.
ModelContractHotloadAccepted.title: ModelContractHotloadAccepted

EnumContractHotloadOperation.description:
What a request or registry record does to one contract name.

Plan section 4 names the three: ``register`` (a name the registry has not
held, ``expected_version: 0``), ``replace`` (a new hash for a held name)
and ``remove``.
EnumContractHotloadOperation.title: EnumContractHotloadOperation

ModelContractHotloadRemoved.description:
The compacted record of one removed contract, keyed by its name.

It carries no ``contract_yaml``: a removal installs nothing.

Attributes:
    entity_id: The contract name (the record's compaction key).
    registry_version: The registry version this removal created.
    content_hash: Canonical content hash of the contract that was removed.
    operation: Always ``remove``.
    owner: The principal that owns the registration.
    registration_request_id: The request this removal answers.
ModelContractHotloadRemoved.title: ModelContractHotloadRemoved

EnumContractHotloadReason.description:
Why the registry rejected a request or a runtime did not apply a change.

The values are the tokens plan sections 3.2 and 4 spell in capitals. Registry
side: ``VERSION_CONFLICT``, ``REQUEST_ID_REUSED``, ``BASELINE_PROTECTED``,
``OWNER_FORBIDDEN``, ``OWNER_MISMATCH``, ``REGISTRY_FROZEN``,
``ALREADY_REGISTERED``, and the four rejection causes of error chain E1
(``NOT_INSTALLED``, ``HASH_NOT_INSTALLED``, ``HANDLER_OUTSIDE_PREFIX``,
``PROFILE_NOT_LOADED``). Runtime side: ``PACKAGE_HASH_MISMATCH``,
``NO_PROVISIONER``, ``CORE_RUNTIME_OWNED``, ``DUPLICATE_COMMAND_OWNER``,
``TOPIC_SPEC_CONFLICT``, ``STORE_UNAVAILABLE``. First-request ingress:
``CONTRACT_NOT_ANNOUNCED``, ``NOT_ADMITTED``, ``HASH_DRIFT``.
EnumContractHotloadReason.title: EnumContractHotloadReason

EnumContractLoadOutcome.description: How the registry answered one contract load request.
EnumContractLoadOutcome.title: EnumContractLoadOutcome

ModelContractLoadReply.description:
One reply per request: accepted, rejected, unchanged or replayed.

Attributes:
    entity_id: Identifies the sender principal and the request id together, so
        one request has one reply (the reply topic's compaction-free key).
    outcome: How the registry answered.
    reason: Typed reason, or ``None`` when the outcome needs none. The field is
        required: a reply states its reason or states there is none.
    registry_version: The registry version the answer is about.
ModelContractLoadReply.title: ModelContractLoadReply

ModelContractRevision.description:
A contract at one content hash, with its text.

Attributes:
    entity_id: ``{name}@{content_hash}``, the record's compaction key.
    contract_yaml: The contract, as text.
    registry_version: The registry version that registered this revision.
ModelContractRevision.title: ModelContractRevision

ModelRegistryWatermark.description:
The highest committed and highest published change sequence, and when.

Attributes:
    entity_id: Fixed: ``registry-watermark``. The topic holds one key.
    committed_sequence: The highest change sequence the registry committed.
    published_sequence: The highest change sequence published to the bus.
    observed_at: When the registry read these two values (timezone-aware).
ModelRegistryWatermark.title: ModelRegistryWatermark

EnumContractHotloadStatus.description:
The outcome of one registry change at one runtime instance.

Used by the applied event and by the ``observed`` entry of the runtime state
record (plan section 3.2): ``materialized``, ``adopted``, ``replaced``,
``removed``, ``refused`` (with a reason), ``not_ready`` and ``failed``.
EnumContractHotloadStatus.title: EnumContractHotloadStatus

ModelContractHotloadApplied.description:
What one runtime instance did with one registry change.

Attributes:
    entity_id: The contract name.
    registry_version: The registry version the runtime acted on.
    content_hash: Canonical content hash of the contract acted on.
    operation: The operation the runtime applied or refused.
    status: ``materialized``, ``adopted``, ``replaced``, ``removed``,
        ``refused``, ``not_ready`` or ``failed``.
    reason: Typed reason, or ``None``. A ``refused`` event must carry one.
    runtime_instance_id: The runtime instance.
    incarnation_id: The incarnation of that instance (fresh at each process start).
    profile: The runtime profile.
    lane: The lane the runtime serves.
    image_digest: Digest of the image the runtime runs.
ModelContractHotloadApplied.title: ModelContractHotloadApplied

ModelHotloadNameState.description:
The observed and the served entry of one owned name.

Attributes:
    observed: What the runtime has folded for the name.
    served: What it has wired, or ``None`` when nothing is served (after a
        removal, or while a first load is refused).
ModelHotloadNameState.title: ModelHotloadNameState

ModelHotloadObservedEntry.description:
What the runtime has observed for one name (plan section 3.2).

It is the highest accepted or removal version the runtime has folded, with the
status of that record. After a refused replacement it reads version 2,
``refused``; after a removal it reads version n, ``removed``.

Attributes:
    registry_version: The highest version folded.
    status: What the runtime did with that record.
    reason: Typed reason, or ``None``. A ``refused`` entry must carry one.
ModelHotloadObservedEntry.title: ModelHotloadObservedEntry

ModelHotloadServedEntry.description:
The hash and version currently wired for one name (plan section 3.2).

A reader that needs the served revision's declarations joins this name and
content hash to the registry's revisions topic.
ModelHotloadServedEntry.title: ModelHotloadServedEntry

ModelRuntimeHotloadState.description:
The compacted state record of one runtime instance (plan section 3.2).

Published on the workload's own state topic, which only that workload's
principal may write, so a reader takes the workload from the topic and never
from this payload. It is not a response, so it carries no request id. A clean
shutdown publishes a null for the key, which is a tombstone and not a record.

Attributes:
    entity_id: The runtime instance id (the record's compaction key).
    incarnation_id: Fresh at each process start.
    profile: The runtime profile.
    lane: The lane the runtime serves.
    image_digest: Digest of the image the runtime runs.
    bootstrap_ready: True once the baseline is attached and the follower has
        caught up with the accepted topic.
    serving_ready: True once every owned accepted contract the image can serve
        is attached.
    names: For each owned name, what the runtime observed and what it serves.
ModelRuntimeHotloadState.title: ModelRuntimeHotloadState
